_about: Public-domain J. H. Kurtz (1809-1890, Lutheran, professor at Dorpat) in pre-1930 English translations: Church History (3 vols, tr. John Macpherson, 2nd ed., Hodder & Stoughton, 1891-93), clean from Gutenberg; and from the Internet Archive History of the Old Covenant (3 vols, tr. Alfred Edersheim and James Martin; Philadelphia, 1859), Sacrificial Worship of the Old Testament (tr. James Martin; Clark, 1863) and Manual of Sacred History (tr. Charles F. Schaeffer; Philadelphia, year not legible). Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 16 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

kurtz-church-history-1: Church History, vol. 1, tr. John Macpherson, second edition (London: Hodder & Stoughton, MDCCCXCI)
kurtz-church-history-2: Church History, vol. 2, tr. John Macpherson, second edition (London: Hodder & Stoughton, MDCCCXCII)
kurtz-church-history-3: Church History, vol. 3, tr. John Macpherson, second edition (London: Hodder & Stoughton, MDCCCXCIII)

kurtz-old-covenant-1: History of the Old Covenant, vol. 1, tr. Alfred Edersheim (Philadelphia: Lindsay & Blakiston, 1859)
kurtz-old-covenant-2: History of the Old Covenant, vol. 2, tr. James Martin (Philadelphia: Lindsay & Blakiston, 1859)
kurtz-old-covenant-3: History of the Old Covenant, vol. 3, tr. James Martin (Philadelphia: Lindsay & Blakiston, 1859)
kurtz-sacrificial-worship-1863: Sacrificial Worship of the Old Testament, tr. James Martin (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, MDCCCLXIII); the translator's name OCRs as "JAMES MAETIN", so it is not machine-checked
kurtz-sacred-history: Manual of Sacred History, tr. Charles F. Schaeffer from the sixth German edition (Philadelphia: Lindsay & Blakiston; year not legible, Schaff's letter dated 1855)

_alternates.kurtz-church-history-edersheim: the earlier Church History translation 'with emendations' by Edersheim (Clark, 1860-64; IA historyofchristi01kurt, 02kurt)
_alternates.kurtz-church-history-pg-onevol: Gutenberg 51491: the three Church History volumes in one file
